text.body: mīmāṃsānyāyaprakāśaḥ | yatkṛpāleśamātreṇa puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam | prāpyate tamahaṃ vande govindaṃ bhaktavatsalam || anantaguṇasampanna manantabhajanapriyam | anantarūpiṇaṃ vande gurumānandarūpiṇam || iha khalu paramakāruṇikena bhagavatā jaiminyṛṣiṇā athāto dharmajijñāsetyādinā dvādaśasu adhyāyeṣu dharmo vicāritaḥ | tatra vedena prayojana muddiśya vidhīyamāno'rtho dharmaḥ yathā yāgādiḥ sa hi yajeta svargakāma ityādivākyena khargamuddiśya vidhīyate | tathā hi yajetetyatrāsti aṃśaddayaṃ yajirdhātuḥ pratyayaca | tatra pratyaye'pyasti aṃśaddayam ākhyātatva' liṅtvañca | ākhyātatvañca daśasu lakāreṣu vidyate liṅtvañca punaḥ kevalaṃ liṅayeva | tatrākhyātatvalitvābhyāṃ bhāvanaivocyate | bhāvanā nāma bhaviturbhavanānukūlo bhāvakavyāpāraviśeṣaḥ | sā ca dvividhā śābdī bhāvanā ārthī bhāvanā ceti 1 tatra puruṣapravṛttyanukūla bhāvakavyāpāraviśeṣā śābdī bhāvanā | sā ca liṅtvāṃśenocyate | liṅśravaṇe'yaṃ māṃ pravarttayati matpravṛttyanukūlavyāpāravānayamiti niyamena pratīyamānatvāt | yacca yasmāt pratīyate tattasya vācyam | gośabdasya gotvaṃ sa ca pravṛttyanukūlavyāpāraviśeṣo loke puruṣaniṣṭho'bhiprāyaviśeṣaḥ vede tu puruṣābhāvāt liṅādiśabdaniṣṭha eva | na hi vedaḥ puruṣanirmitaḥ vedasyādhyayanaṃ sarvaṃ gurvadhyayanapūrvakaṃ vedādhyayanasāmānyādadhunādhyayanaṃ yathetyādinā vedāpauruṣeyatvasya sādhitatvāt | yaḥ kalpaḥ sa kalpapūrva iti nyāyena saṃsārasyānāditvādīśvarasya ca sarvajñatvādīśvaro gatakalpīyaṃ yathā vedamasmin kalpe smṛtvā upadiśatītyetāvataivopapattau pramāṇāntareṇārthamupalabhya racitatvakalpanānupapatteśca | tataśca puruṣābhāvācchabdaniṣṭhaiva sā śrata eva śābdī bhāvaneti vyapadiśanti | sā ca śābdī bhāvanā aṃśatrayamapekṣate sādhya sādhanamiti karttavyatāṃ ceti | tatra sādhyākāṅgāyāṃ vacyamāṇāṃśattrayīpetārthī bhāvanā sādhyatvena sambadhyate ekapratyayagamyatvena samānābhidhānaśruteḥ | yadyapi saṃkhyādīnāmapyekapratyayagamyatvaṃ samānaṃ tathāpyayogyatvānna teṣāṃ bhāvyatvenānvayaḥ | karaṇākāṅkṣāyāṃ liṅādijñānaṃ karaṇatvena sambadhyate tasya ca karaṇatvaṃ na bhāvano tpādakatvena sannikarṣasyeva rūpādijñāne sannikarṣāt prāk rūpajñānasyeva liṅādijñānāt prāk śabdavarmabhāvanāyā prabhāvaprasaṅgāt | kintu bhāvanābhāvyanirvarttakatvena liṅgādijñānaṃ hi śabdabhāvanābhāvyārthī bhāvanāṃ nirvarttayati kuṭhāra iva cheṭanam | ato liṅgādijñānasya karaṇatvenānvayaḥ | itikarttavyatākāṅkṣāyāṃ prāśastyajñānamitikarttavyatātvena sambadhyate | tacca prāśastyajñānaṃ vāyurve cepiṣṭhā devatetyarthavādairjanyate | te hyarthavādāḥ svārthapratipā dane prayojanamanupalabhamānā lakṣaṇayā kratoḥ prāśastya pratipā dayanti svārthamātraparatve śrānarthakyaprasaṅgāt na ceṣṭāpattiradhyayanavidhyupāttatvenānarthakyānupapatteḥ | tathāhi svādhyāyo'dhyetavya ityadhyayanavidhiḥ sakalasya vedasyādhyayanakarttavyatāṃ bodhayan sarvā vedaḥ prayojanavadarthaparyyavasāyoti sūcayati nirarthakasyādhyayanānupapatteḥ | sa ca vedo vidhimantranāmadheyaniṣedhārthavādātmakaḥ | tatra vidhiḥ prayojanavadarghavidhānenārthavān| sa cāprāptamarthaṃ vidhatte yathā śragnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāma iti vidhiraprāptaṃ prayojanavaddomaṃ vidhatte agnihotrahomena svargaṃ bhāvayediti | yatra tu karma prakārāntareṇa prāptaṃ tatra taduddeśena guṇamātravidhānam | yathā dadhnā juhuyādityatra homasyāgnihotraṃ juhuyādityanena prāptatvāddomoddeśena dadhimātravidhānam | dadhnā homaṃ bhāvayediti | yatra tūbhayamaprāptaṃ tatra viśiṣṭa vidhatte taduktam | na cedanyena śiṣṭā iti śiṣṭā upadiṣṭā ityarthaḥ | yathā somena yajetetyava somayāgayoraprāptatvāt somaviśiṣṭayāgavidhānaṃ somavatā yāgeneṣṭaṃ bhāvayediti | na cobhayavidhāne vākyabhedaḥ viśiṣṭasyaikatvāt viśiṣṭavidhau ca matvarthalacaṇā | yathā somapadena matvartho lakṣyate somavateti na hi matvardhalakṣaṇāṃ vinā somasyānvayaḥ sambhavati yadi tāvat somayāgayoraikyarūpeṇa bhāvanāyāṃ karaṇatvenaivānvayaḥ | somena yāgeneṣṭaṃ bhāvayediti | tata ubhayavidhāne vākyabhedaḥ somasya yāgavatphalabhāvanākaraṇatvenāpratyakṣavirodhañca | na hi somo yāgo bhavitumarhati dhānyaprasaṅgāpātaca yāgārthatvānupapattiśca yāge dravyānupapattiśca | pratyayavācyabhāvanāyāḥ samānapadopāttena yāgena karaṇākāṅkṣānivṛttatvena bhinnapadopāttasya somasya karaṇatvenānvayānupapattiśca syāt | yadi ca vaiyadhikaraṇya nānvayaḥ tatra na tāvadyāgena somamityanvayaḥ | samānapadopāttatvāt pratyayavācyaphalabhāvanāyāṃ karaṇatvenānvitasya yāgasya somakarmakabhāvanānvayānupapatteḥ yāgasya somārthatvāpatteśca | na ceṣṭāpattiraṭṭaṣṭadvayāpatteḥ na hi yāgasya somārthatva, dṛṣṭadvāreṇa sambhavati vrīhiṣu avaghāteneva yāgena some kasyacida dṛṣṭasyājananāt | atastena tāvat some kiñcidadṛṣṭaṃ jananīyaṃ prokṣaṇeneva vrīhiṣu | tathā yāgasya somārthatve phalabhāvanāyāṃ somasya karaṇatvenānvayo vaktavyaḥ bhāvanākaraṇatvañca bhāvanābhāvyanivarttakatvenetyuktam | na ca somaḥ adṛṣṭamantareṇa phalaṃ janayitu ṃ samarthaḥ grahairjuhototi vākya vihitahomena tasya bhasmobhāvāt | ato dṛṣṭadayāpātānna yāgasya somārthatvamiti na yāgena somaṃ bhāvayedityanvayaḥ sambhavati karaṇatvenopasthitasya somasya sādhyatvenānvayānupapatteśca | Į atha somena yāgaṃ bhāvayedityanvayaḥ | tatra yadyapi somasya karaṇatvena yāgārthatvād yāganivṛttirdṛṣṭameva prayojanaṃ labhyate iti nādṛṣṭadayāpattiḥ | nāpi karaṇatvenopasthitasya somasya sādhyatvānvayānupapattiḥ | karaṇatvenaivānvayāt | tathāpyaprāptatvāt bhāvanākaraṇatvenānvitasya yāgasya sādhyatvenānvayānupattistadavasyaiva | nanu yajetetyatra yāgasya na karaṇatvena nāpi sādhyatvenopasthitiḥ | tadvācakaṭatoyādyabhāvāt | kintu bhāvanāyāṃ yāgasambandhamāvaṃ pratīyate yāgasya ca bhāvanāsambandhaḥ karaṇatvena sādhyatvena ca sambhavati tatra karaṇatvāṃśamādāya phala sambandhaḥ | sādhyatvāṃśamādāya guṇasambandhaśca syāditi cennaivam | yadyapi bhāvanayā yāgasya sambandhamātraṃ pratīyate tathāpi karaṇatvenopasthitidaśāyāṃ na sādhyatvenopasthitiḥ sambhavati virodhāt | tadavaśvaṃ yāgena svargaṃ bhāvayediti karaṇatvenānvaye sati paścāt somena yāgaṃ bhāvayediti sādhyatvenānvayo vaktavyaḥ tataśca bākyabhedaḥ | na ca pratyayābhihitabhāvanāsvarūpe yāgasvarūpamātramanvetīti vaktu' yukta' kārakāṇāmeva kriyānvayāt | tasihaṃ somasya na yāge sāmānādhikaraṇyena vānvayaḥ sambhavatīti } nanu yajetetyatra pratyayābhihitabhāvanāyāḥ karaṇākāṅkṣāyāṃ yathā yāgaḥ karaṇatvenānveti | tathā itikarttavyatākāṅkṣāyāṃ somasya itikarttavyatātvena bhāvanāyāmevānvayo'stu kiṃ matvarthalakṣaṇayeti cenmaivam | someneti tṛtīyayā karaṇatvavācinyā somasyetikarttavyatātvānabhidhānāt | tatra yadi itikarttavyatāla lakṣaṇayocyate tato vara somapade eva prakṛtibhūte matvarthalakṣaṇā guye tvayāyya kalpaneti nyāyāt | atha vedo vā prāyadarśanādityadhikaraṇenokkāsañjātavirodhitvanyāyenāntye pratyaya eva lakṣaṇeti cet tathāpi somasyetikarttavyatātvenānvayānupapattiḥ | siddhasya vastuna itikarttavyatātvābhāvāt kriyāyā evetikattaṃvyatātvāt dravyasya kevalamaṅgatvāt śrataevetikarttavyatātvābhāvāt dravyasya prakaraṇādagrahaṇam | yathāhuḥ " nāvāntarakriyāyogādṛte vākyopakalpitāt | guṇadravye kathaṃ bhāvairgṛhṛnti prakṛtāḥ kriyā iti || tadetadagre vakṣāmaḥ | kiṃ ca somena yajetiti hi yāgasyotpattivākyaṃ nādhikāravākya' jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajetetyasyādhikāravākyatvāt utpattivākye ca netikarttavyatākāṅkṣā iṣṭaviśeṣākāṅkṣā kaluṣitatvenetikarttavyatākāṅkṣāyā vispaṣṭānutthānāt | tatsiddhaṃ somasya netikarttavyatātvena bhāvanāyāmanvayaḥ | tasmāda viśiṣṭavidhau anvayānupapattyā avaśyaṃ matvaryalakṣaṇā vāceti | nanu evamapi somena yajetetyatra na viśiṣṭa vidhānaṃ gauravāt matvarthala kṣaṇāpātācca | kintu dadhnā juhototivadguṇamātravidhānamastu vidhiśakte guṇopasaṃkramāt yathāhuḥ | "sarvatrākhyātamambaḍe śrūyamāṇe padāntare | vidhiśaktya upasaṃkrānteḥ syāddhātoranuvādateti | " na ca yāgasyāprāptatvānna taduddeśena somavidhānamiti vācyam | jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajetetyanena yāgasya prāptatvāt | na ca asyādhikāravidhitvena na, utpattividhitvamiti vācyam | udbhidā yajeta paśukāma itivadekasyaivobhayavidhitvopapatteḥ | evaṃ somena yajetetyatra na matvarthalakṣaṇā yadi hyatra viśiṣṭavidhānaṃ syāttadānvayānupapattyā matvardhalakṣaṇā syāt | jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajetetyava tu. yāgavidhāne kvacitra matvaryalakṣaṇā | na tāvadetasmin vākye jyotiṣṭomena yāgena svargaṃ bhāvayediti sāmānādhikaraṇyenaiva nāmapadasyānvayāt | nāpi momena yajetetyatra matvaryalakṣaṇāyā yāgoddeśena somavidhānāt momena yāgaṃ bhāvayediti | nanu anuvāde'pyasti matvaryalakṣaṇā | śrataevoktaṃ "vidhāne vānuvāde vā yāṃgaḥ karaṇamiṣyate | tatsamīpe tṛtīyāntastaddācitvaṃ na muñcatoti |" ataśca viśiṣṭavidhau iva guvidhāvapi astyeva matvarthalakṣaṇeti cenmaivam | guṇānvayānupapattyā hi matvaryalakṣaṇā aṅgīkriyate | yadā ca bhāvanāyāṃ dhātvaryasya karaṇatvena śranvayastadānvayānupapattyā sā aṅgīkarttavyā | guṇavidhau ca na dhātvarthasya karaṇatvenānvayo mānābhāvāt | na hi dadhnā juhotītyatra homasya karaṇatvaṃ śrūyate tadācakaṭatoyādyabhāvāt | kalpāta iti cenna guṇasya tatra vidhitmitatvena sādhyākāṅkṣāyāṃ sādhyatvakalpanāyā evocitatvāt daghnā homaṃ bhāvayediti | na cāyamasti niyamo bhāvanāyāṃ dhātvaryasya karaṇatvenaiva avayo na prakārāntareṇeti ṣaṣṭhādyapūrvapakṣānutthānāpatteḥ | ṣaṣṭhāye hi yajeta svargakāma ityādau pratyayavācyāyāṃ vacyamāṇārthī bhāvanāyāṃ samānapada śrutyā yāgasya bhāvyatvamāśaṅkya apuruṣārthatvena parihṛtam| yadi ca dhātvarthasya karaṇatvenaiva bhāvanāyāmanvayastadā bhāvyatvaśaṅgeva nodetīti vyarthaṃ ṣaṣṭhādyamadhikaraṇamāpadyeta | kiñca vājapeyādhikaraṇe dhātvarthasya karaṇatvenaiva anvaye tanvasambandhaśaṅgeva na syāt tatra tantrasambandhaśaṅkāparihārau ca vyākhyātau | kiñca na dhātvarthasya karaṇatvenaiva anvayaḥ | guṇakāmādhikaraṇe śrāśrayatvena dhātvarthānvayasyoktatvāt | tathāhi dadhendriyakāmasya juhuyādityatra na tāvaddomo vidhīyate tasya vacanāntareṇa vihitatvāt nāpi homasya phalasambandhaḥ guṇapadānarthakyāpatteḥ | nāpi guṇasambandha vidhatte phalapadānarthakyāpātāt nāpyubhayasambandha' vidhatte prāpta tantrasambandhamāśaṅkya parihṛtaḥ kammaiṇi anekavidhāne vākyabhedāpatteḥ | yathāhuḥ " prāpta karmāṇi nānekī vidhātuṃ śakyate guṇaḥ | aprāpte tu vidhīyante bahavo'pyekayatnata iti ||" atra ca kamīpadavada guṇetyupalakṣaṇam | ekoddeśena anekavidhāne vākyabhedāt | ataeva grahaikatvādhikaraṇe graha mammāṣṭatyava grahoddeśena ekatvasambhārgavidhau vākyabhedāt grahaikatvamavivacitamityuktam | revatyadhikaraṇe ca etasyaiva revatīṣu vāravantīyamagniṣṭomasāma kṛtvā paśukāmo hyetena yajetetyatra vāravantīyasya revatīsambandhe agniṣṭomasāmasambandhe phalasambandhe ca vidhīyamāne vākyabhedādbhāvanopasarjana bhāvanāntara vidhīyate ityuktam | tasmāt prāpte home nobhayavidhānaṃ sambhavati nāpi homāntaraṃ vidhīyate. gauravāt prakṛtahānāprakṛtakalpanāprasaṅgācca | satvarthala kṣaṇāprasaṅgācca nāpi dadhyeva kevalaṃ karaṇatvena vidhīyate iti yuktaṃ kevalasya vyāpārānāviṣṭasya karaṇatvānupapatteḥ | kaṭaṃvyāpāravyāpyatvaniyamāt karaṇatvasya | kiṃ tarhi vidhīyate iti cet daghnati tṛtīyayopāttaṃ dadhikaraṇatvaṃ phalabhāvanāyāṃ karaṇatvena vidhīyate pratyayārthatvena daghno'pi tasya prādhānyāt | evañca dadhikaraṇatvena indriyaṃ bhāvayediti, vākyārthaḥ | karaṇatvañca kiṃpratiyogikamityapekṣāyāṃ sannidhiprāpto homa āśrayatvena sambadhyate tataśca siddho dhātvaryasyāśrayatvenānvayaḥ | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | tatsiddhaṃ dhātvarthasya na karaṇenaivānvaya iti kiṃ tarhi kvacit karaṇatvena kvacit sādhyatvena kvacidāśrayatveneti guṇavidhī ca sādhyatvenaivānvayaḥ sambhavatīti na matvaryalakṣaṇyā prayojanam | kiñca guṇa vidhau matvaryalakṣaṇāyāṃ guṇasya dhātvarthīṅgatve kiṃ mānamiti vaktavyam | na tāvacchrutiḥ matvaryalakṣaṇāyāṃ tṛtīyāśrutimatvaryasyaivāṅgatve mānaṃ syāt na guṇasyāṅgatve | samabhivyāhārātmakaṃ vākyamiti cet ? tat kiṃ svatantra meva mānamuta liṅgaśrutau kalpayitvā ? | nādyaḥ | balābalādhikaraṇavirodhāt | tatra hi vākya ṃ liṅgaśrutau kalpayitvā aṅgatve mānamityuktam | dvitīye pratyakṣāṃ śrutimutsṛjya śrutyantarakalpane tasyā eva vā śravṛttikalpane vyarthaḥ prayāsaḥ samāśritaḥ syāt viśiṣṭavidhau cāgatyā tadāśrayaṇam | kiñca bhavatu pratyakṣa eva vā vidhirdhātvarthāṅgatvena guṇaṃ vidhatte ? uta kalpitaṃ vidhyantaram ? kalpitamiti cenna śrutavidhervyarthaṃ tāpatteḥ | na hi tena tadā guṇo vidhīyate kalpitavidhyantarāṅgīkārāt nāpi dhātvarthaḥ tasya vacanāntareṇa vihitatvāt | atha yūyamāṇa eva vidhiḥ kalpitaśrutisahakkato dhātvarthāṅgatvena guṇaṃ vidhatte iti cet tarhi tatra kathaṃ dhātvarthasyānvayaḥ karaṇatveneti cenna anvayānupapatteḥ | na hi sambhavati dadhnā homeneti cānvayaḥ sādhyatvenaivānvayo dadhnā homaṃ bhāvayediti cenna | tathā sati śranuvāde'pi dhātvarthaḥ karaṇatvenevānvetītyetadupekṣitaṃ syāt | vivacitavākyārthaya vinaiva matvartha lakṣaṇayā aṅgīkṛtaḥ syāt tasmānna guṇavidhī matvartha lakṣaṇā | yattu vidhāne vā anuvāde veti vārttikaṃ tat pratītimavalambā na vastugatim | tathāhi yāvaddhi agnihotraṃ juhuyāditi vākyaṃ nālīcyate kevalaṃ ca dadhnā juhotauti vākyamālocyate taḍā ṣaṣṭhādyanyāyena homasyābhāvyatāṃ jānatāṃ pratipadādhikaraṇabhāvārthādhikaraṇavāsanāvāsitānāṃ bhavatyetādṛśau matiḥ yaddadhimatā homeneṣṭaṃ bhāvayediti | pratipadādhikaraṇe hi somena yajetetyādiṣu kiṃ guṇadhātvarthayoḥ phalabhāvanākaraṇatvenānvayaḥ ? uta ekasyaiva ? iti sandihya pradhānasambandhalābhāt vinigamanāvira hācca sarveṣāṃ phalabhāvanākaraṇatvenānvayamāśaṅkya lāghavādekasyaiva śrutyantarakalpanaṃ tathāpi tatsahakṛtaḥ bhāvanākaraṇatvamityuktam | bhāvanākaraṇatvaṃ hi bhāvanābhāvya nirvarttakatayā bhāvyaṃ ca svargādinā dṛṣṭamantareṇeti anekeṣāṃ karaṇatve anekādṛṣṭakalpanāprasaṅgāt | tasmādekasyaiva karaṇatvaṃ yadāpyekasya tadāpi kiṃ dravyaguṇayoḥ phalabhāvanākaraṇatvamuta dhātvaryasyeti bhāvārthādhikaraṇe sandihya dravyaguṇayoreva bhāvanākaraṇatvam | bhūtaṃ bhavyāyopadiśyate iti nyāyādityāśaṅkā dhātvarthasyaiva bhāvanākaraṇatvaṃ padaśruterbalīyastvādityuktam | ataśca siddhametaddākyāntarānālocanadaśāyāṃ guṇavidhāvapi dhātvarthasya karaṇatvāśaṅkāyāṃ guṇapade matvartha lakṣaṇeti | yadā tvagnihotraṃ juhotīti homavidhāyaka vākyāntaramālocyate tadā homasya vākyāntareṇaiva vihitatvāttaduddeśena guṇamātra' vidhīyata ityālocanātra matvarthalakṣaṇeti | ataevoktaṃ pārthasārathimivairādhārāgnihotrādhikaraṇe phalato guṇavidhirayaṃ na pratītita iti | yadvā etaddārttikamadhikāravidhyabhiprāyam | udbhidā yajetetyādīnāmadhikārāt tatra hi yāgo vidhīyatāmutpattivākyasiddho vā anūdyatāmubhayathāpi karaṇatvenānvayāt tṛtīyāntasya taddācitvaṃ anyathā anvayānupapatteriti | tasmādguṇavidhī vināpi matvarthalacaṇayā anvayopapatterna matvartha lakṣaṇeti | ataśca somena yajetetyatra na viśiṣṭavidhānaṃ kintu guṇamāvavidhānaṃ yāgastu jyotiṣṭomena svarga, kāmo yajetetyetasmin vākye vidhīyata ityeva yuktam anyathā matvartha lakṣaṇāpatteriti | atrocyate yadyapi yāgoī śena somavidhau na matvarthalakṣaṇā tathāpi matvarthalacaṇā tathāpi yāgasyāprāptatvāt somena yajetetyatra na yāgoddeśena somavidhānaṃ sambhavati | na ca jyotiṣṭomena ityādinā prāptatvāt taduddeśena guṇamātraṃ vidhīyate iti vācyam | tasyādhikāravidhitvenotpattividhitvānupapatteḥ | karmasvarūpamātrabodhako vidhirutpattividhiḥ | tena ca vihitasya karmaṇaḥ phalaviśeṣa sambandhamātramadhikāravidhinā kriyate phalaviśeṣasambandhabodhakasyādhikāra vidhitvāt | yathā āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo bhavatītyetadvihitasya karmaṇaḥ phalaviśeṣasambandhamātraṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeteti vākyaṃ vidhatte tasyādhikāravidhitvaṃ notpattividhitvam syādetad darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmityetasya notpattividhitvaṃ sambhavati | āgneyo'ṣṭākapāla ityādivākyānarthakyāpatteḥ | na hi tena tadā kama vidhīyate tasya darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmityanena vihitatvāt | nāpi guṇavidhāna sambhavati prāpta karmaṇi anekaguṇavidhāne vākyabhedāpatteḥ | ata āgneyo'ṣṭākapāla ityasyotpattividhitvaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmityasya cādhikāravidhitvaṃ yuktam | jyotiṣṭomenetyasyādhikāravidherudbhidā yajetapaśukāma ityādivadutpattividhitve svīkriyamāṇe na kasyacidānarthakyam | somena yajetetyasya guṇavidhitvāt yāgoddeśena somamātravidhānācca na vākyabheda iti cennaivam | yadyapi somena yajetetyatra lāghavānna vākyabhedaḥ tathāpi jyotiṣṭomena ityasmin vākye karmasvarūpe tasya ca phalasambandha vidhīyamāne gauravalakṣaṇo vākyabhedo'styeva | somena yajetetyetaddākā vihitakarmaṇaḥ phalasambandhamāvavidhāne tadabhāvāt udbhidā yajetetyatra tu vacanāntarābhāvena agatyā tadāśrayaṇam | somena yajetetyatrāpi kakharūpe guṇe ca vidhīyamāne vākyabhedaḥ syāditi vācyam | śrūyamāṇena vidhinā guṇasyāvidheyatvāt | viśeṣaṇavidherārthikatvāt sarvatra hi viśiṣṭavidhau viśeṣaṇavidhirārthikaḥ | jyotiṣṭomenetyasya tūtpattividhitve kama svarūpaṃ phalasambandhaśceti śrūyamāṇenaiva vidhinā vidhātavyamiti dṛḍho gaurava na ca lakṣaṇo vākyabhedaḥ | yathāhuḥ | "śrotavyāpāranānātve śabdānāmatigauravam | ekoktyavasitānāntu nārthācepo virudhyata" iti | na ca somena yajetetyasyotpattividhitve yadyapi na vākyabhedaḥ tathāpi matvardhalakṣaṇā syādeveti vācyam | tasyāḥ svīkriyamāṇatvāt lakṣaṇā ato vākyabhedasya jaghanyatyāt lakṣaṇā hi padadoṣo vākyabhedastu vākyadoṣaḥ padavākyadoṣayormadhye pada eva doṣakalpanāyā ucitatvāt | guṇe tvanyāyyakalpaneti nyāyāt| ataeva jātaputraḥ kṛṣṇakeśo'gnīnādadhīta itvatvādhānānuvādena jātaputratvakṛṣṇa keśatvavidhāne vākyabhedāt padaddayābhyāmavasthāviśeṣo lakṣyata ityuktam | tasmāddākyabhedaprasaktau lakṣaṇaiva svokāthyā | tasmāt somena yajetetyayamevotpattividhirna jyotiṣṭomenetyayam | gauravalakṣaṇavākyabhedāpatteḥ | kiñca somena yajetetyatra yāgavidhāne śratyarthavidhānaṃ syāt guṇavidhāne tu vākyārthavidhānam | tacca śrutyarthavidhāne sambhave'yuktam | yathāhuḥ "vākyārthavidhiranyāyyaḥ śrutyarthavidhisambhava" iti vākyārthaḥ padāntarārtha ityarthaḥ | jyotiṣṭomenetyatrāpi phaloddeśena yāgasyaiva vidhānānna vākyārthavidhānam | tadutpattividhitvavādināpi tadaṅgīkārācca tasmāt jyotiṣṭomenetyayamadhikāravidhireva | api ca karmasvarūpavidhistava | svīkāryyo yatna karmaṇo rūpamupalabhyate | yāgasya ca dve rūpe dravyaṃ devatā ceti | somena yajetetyatra yadyapi devatā nopalabhyate somayāgasyāvyaktatvāt | śravyaktatvañca svārthacoditadevatārāhityam na tu devatārāhityamātram | aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇātītyādivākyavihitagrahaṇāṅgadevatānāṃ sattvāt grahaṇārthābhirapi devatābhiḥ prasaṅgato yāgopakārasya kriyamāṇatvāt | tathāpi dravya. mupalabhyata eva tenāpi yāgasvarūpaṃ jñātuṃ śakyameva | jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajetetyatra ca na dravyaṃ devatā vā śrūyate śratastasyotpattividhitvena yāgaviśeṣajñānaṃ yāgasāmānyasyāvidheyatvāt viśeṣasyaiva vidheyatvādityādikleśena syāt | ato nāyaṃ karmotpattividhiḥ | nanu evamapi agnihotraṃ juhotītyayamapi homotpattividhirna syāt rūpāśravaṇāt | tacchravaṇācca daghnā juhotītyayameva utpattividhiḥ syāt | tathā cāghārāgnihotrādhikaraṇa virodhaḥ | tatra hi agnihotraṃ juhotītyasyotpattividhitvaṃ daghnā juhoto. tyādīnāṃ ca guṇavidhitvamuktamiti cet satyam | agnihotraṃ juhotītyatra yadyapi rūpaṃ nopalabhyate agnihotraśabdasya tatprakhyanyāyena nāmadheyatvāt tadetadagre vacyāmaḥ | tathāpi tasyotpattividhitvaṃ khaukriyate anyathā ānartha kyāpatteḥ | dadhnā juhotītyasya ca nānarthakyaṃ guṇavidhitvopapatteḥ | ataḥ agnihotraṃ juhotītyayaṃ karmotpattividhiriti yuktam | jyotiṣṭomenetyasya ca nānarthakyamadhikāravidhitvopapatteḥ | ataḥ kimarthaṃ sambhavata rūpavati vākye karmavidhāne tadrahite tat svīkāryyam | kiñca dadhnā juhotītyasya karmotpattividhitve payasā juhotyanenaitatkarmānuvādena na payo vidhātuṃ śakyate utpattiśiṣṭadadhyavarodhāt utpatiśiṣṭaguṇāvaruḍe hi na guṇāntaraṃ vidhīyate ākāṅkṣāyā utpattiśiṣṭenaiva nivṛttatvāt | atastenāpi śiṣṭaṃ karmāntaraṃ vidheyam | tathā ca anekādṛṣṭakalpanā gauravam śragnihotra' juhotītyasya tu utpattividhitve etadvākyavihitasya karmaṇo dravyākāṅkṣāyāṃ yugapadeva khale kapotanyāyena dadhnā juhoti payasā juhotītyādivākyerguṇā vidhīyante iti nānekādṛṣṭakalpanā gauravam ato'gnihotra juhotītyayamutpattividhiḥ | payasā juhotītyādayastu guṇavidhaya iti yuktam | somena yajetyatra tu rūpavati vākye karmotpattividhāne svīkriyamāṇe na kiñciddapaṇaṃ pacaddaye'pi ekasyādṛṣṭasya tulyatvāt tasmāda yuktam somena yajetetyayamevotpattividhiriti alamanayā vidhinirūpaṇāgataprapañca nirūpaṇacintayā | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | tatsiddhaṃ vidhiḥ prayojanavanta maprāptārthaṃ vidhatte iti | sa ca vidhiścaturvidha utpattividhirviniyogavidhiradhikāravidhiḥ prayogavidhiśceti | tatra karmasvarūpamātrabodhako vidhirutpattividhiḥ | yathā śragnihotraṃ juhotīti utpattividhau ca karmaṇaḥ karaṇatvenaivānvayaḥ | homeneṣṭaṃ bhāvayediti | na tu homaṃ kuryyāditi sādhyatvena | tathā sati sādhyasya sādhyāntarānvayāyogenādhikāravākyagataphalasambandho na syāt karaṇatvena tvanvaye homeneṣṭaṃ bhāvayet | kiṃ tadiṣṭamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ phalaviśeṣasambandhī ghaṭate na cotpattividhāviṣṭavācakapadābhāvena karmayā iṣṭaṃ bhāvayediti kathaṃ vākyārtha iti vācyam | vidhiśrutereva dṛṣṭabodhakatvāt sā hi puruṣārthaṃ puruṣaṃ pravarttayantī karmaṇaḥ phalasambandhamātra bodhayati tasmāda yuktamutpattividhau karma karaṇatvenānvetīti | ataevodbhidā yajetetyādau tṛtīyāntaḥ udbhicchavda upapadyate udbhidā yāgeneṣṭaṃ bhāvayedityanvayopapatteḥ | yeṣāmapi dṛṣṭasādhanatvaṃ liṅaryasteṣāmapi tṛtīyāntānāṃ karmanāmadheyānāmanvayo'nupapanna eva na hi sambhavati | yāga dṛṣṭasādhanamudbhideti tṛtīyopāttasya kārakasya liṅgasaṃkhyānvayāyogyasya kriyayaivānvayāt | nanu tathāpyagnihotra' juhotītyādiṣu karmotpattividhiṣu dvitīyāntānāṃ karmanāmadheyānāmanvayo'nupapannaḥ na hi sambhavati homena bhāvayedagnihotramiti satyam | śrūyamāṇā tāvadu dditīyā arthākṣiptasādhyatvānuvādikā homasya hi karaṇatvenānvayāt asādhitasya karaṇatvānupapatteḥ | tasyāścānanvayopasthitau sā śaktūn juhotītivat tṛtīyārthaṃ lacayati agnihotreṇa homeneṣṭaṃ bhāvayedityuktam pārthasārathimiśraḥ | ataśca dvitīyāntānāṃ karmanāmadheyānāmanvayo nānupapannaḥ | tatsiddam utpattividhau karma karaṇatvenānvetīti | aṅgapradhāna sambandhabodhako vidhirviniyogavidhiḥ | yathā dadhnā juhotīti sa hi tṛtīyāpratipannāṅgabhāvasya dadhno homasambandhaṃ vidhatte daghnā homaṃ bhāvayediti | etasya vidheḥ sahakāribhūtāni ṣaṭ pramāṇāni śrutiliṅgavākya prakaraṇasthānasamākhyārūpāṇi | etatsahatena viniyogavidhināṅgatvaṃ paroddeśapravṛttakkṛtivyāpyatvarūpaṃ parārthāparaparyyāyaṃ jñāpyate | tatra nirapekṣo ravaḥ śrutiḥ | sā ca trividhā vidhātrī abhidhātrī viniyoktī ceti | tatra vidhātrī liṅāyātmikā | abhidhātrī vrīhyādiśrutiḥ | yasya ca śabdasya śravaṇādeva sambandhaḥ pratīyateṃ sā viniyoktī | sā ca dvidhā vibhaktirūpā ekā samānābhidhānarūpā ekā ekapadarūpā ceti | tatra vibhaktiśrutyāṅgatvam | yathā brohibhiryajeteti tṛtīyāśrutyā vrīhoṇāṃ yāgāṅgatvam | na cotpattiśiṣṭapuroḍāśāvaruḍe yāge kathaṃ vrohīṇāmaṅgatvamiti vācyam | puroḍāśaprakṛtitayopapatteḥ paśoriva hṛdayādirūpahaviḥ prakṛtitayā yāgāṅgatvam | na ca sākṣāt paśorevāṅgatvaṃ kiṃ na syāditi vācam | tasya viśasanāt śravadīyamānatvācca hṛdayādīnām | śravadīyamānaṃ hi haviḥ yathā puroḍāśādimadhyāt pūrvārddhāccāvadyatīti vākyāt hṛdayādīni cāvadīyamānāni na paśuḥ hṛdayasyāgre'vadyatīti vākyādatī hṛdayādīnyeva havīṃṣi paśustu prakṛtidravyam | pātnauvad yāge tu sākṣāt paśuvāṅgam | tasya jīvata eva paryyāgnikṛtaṃ pātnīvantamutsṛjatītyutsargavidhānāt | yatra tu viśasanaṃ tatra paśuḥ prakṛtidravyamityeva siddham evaṃ vrīhayo'pi prakṛtidravyatayā yāgāṅgam | tṛtīyā śratyeti śraruṇyasyāpi krayāṅgatvam | tṛtīyāśrutyā na cāmūrttasya tasya kathaṃ krayāṅgatvamiti vācyam| ekahāyanīrūpadravya paricchedaddārā tadupapatteḥ | vrīhaun procatīti prokṣayasya vrīhyaṅgatvaṃ dvitīyāśrutyā tacca prokṣaṇaṃ na vrīhisvarūpārthaṃ svarūpe anarthakyāt vrīhikharūpasya procaṇaṃ trinā anupapattyabhāvāt | kintva pūrva sādhanatvaprayukta yadi vrīhiṣu prokṣaṇaṃ kriyate tadā teryāge anuṣṭhite apūrva bhavati nānyatheti | ataḥ prakaraṇa sahakṛtayā dvitīyayā śrutyā taṇḍulanirvṛttipraṇālyā yadapūrvasādhanatvaṃ tadaṅgatvaṃ prokṣaṇasyocyata iti evaṃ sarveṣu apyaṅgeṣu apūrvayuktatva' veditavyam | evamimāmagṭabhrān raśanāmṛtasya ityaśvābhidhānīmādatta ityatrāpi dvitīyāśrutyā mantrasyāśvābhidhānyaṅgatvam | yattu vākyoyo'yaṃ viniyoga iti tanna tathā sati vākyālliṅgasya balīyastvana yāvaddākyādakhābhidhānyaṅgaṃ bhavati tāvalliṅgādraśanāmātrāṅgatvameva syāt syonante sadanaṃ kṛṇomītyasyeva sadanāṅgatvam | śrauta viniyogapakṣe tu yāvalliṅgādraśanāmātrāṅgatvaṃ tāvacchrutyā aindrayā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate ityatra ṭatīyāśrutyā aindrayā ṛcaḥ gārhapatyopasthānāṅgatvavat akhābhidhānyāṃ viniyogaḥ kriyata iti yukta mantrasyāśvābhidhānyaṅgatvam | tasmāt śrauta evāyaṃ viniyogaḥ | yadāhavanīye juho' tītyāhavanīyasya homāṅgatvaṃ saptamīśrutyā evamanyo'pi vibhaktiśrutyā viniyogo jñeyaḥ | paśunā yajetetyatraikatvaṃ puṃstvayoḥ samānābhidhānaśrutyā kārakāṅgatvaṃ yajetetyākhyātābhihitasaprāyā bhāvanātvaṃ samānābhidhānaśruterekapadaśrutvā ca yāgātatvam | na cāmūrttāyāstasyāḥ kathaṃ yāgāṅgatvamiti vācyam | karṭaparicchedadvārā etadupapatteḥ karttā cākṣepalabhya śrākhyātena hi bhāvanocyate sā ca karttāraṃ vinānupapannā tamākṣipati | nanu kimityevaṃ varṇyate ākṣepalabhyaḥ kartteti | ākhyātavācya eva kiṃ na syāt ākhyātaśravaṇe bhāvanāyā iva kartturapi pratipatteḥ | na ca bhāvanayaivākṣepasambhave kimiti tadvācakatvaṃ kalpanīyamiti | sāmprataṃ tathā sati śrākhyātavāccakarteva bhāvanākṣepasambhave tadvācakatvamapi na syāt | kiñca bhāvanāyā na kevalaṃ karteva sambandhaḥ kārakāntareṇāpi sambandhāt | ataḥ sā na jhaṭiti karttāramevākṣipet viśeṣābhāvāt | karttā tu bhāvanayaiva sambaḍo na kārakāntareṇa guṇānāñca parārthatvādasambandhaḥ samatvāt syāditi nyāyāt | ataḥ sa jhaṭiti tāmevākṣipet iti sa evākhyātavācyaḥ bhāvanā tu ākṣepalabhyaiva kiṃ na syāt | kiñcaivaṃ tṛtīyādivibhaktīnāmapi karaṇādivācakatvaṃ na syāt teṣāmapi karttṛvadākṣepalābhasambhavāt | kiñca yadi karttā na vācyaḥ syāt kathamekatvaṃ tenānvi yāt | na hi śābdamaśābdenānvetīti yuktam anyathā ūhādilopaprasaṅgaḥ | kiñca devadattaḥ pacatīti sāmānādhikaraṇya na syāt | na hi kevalaṃ bhāvanāvācakasyākhyātasya devadattapadena sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyate ekārthaniṣṭhatvābhāvāt | kartṛvācakatve tūpapadyate eva | laḥ karttarīti vyākaraṇasmṛti'virodhastu kartturanabhidheyatve spaṣṭa eva | kiñca kartturanabhidheyatve devadatvena pacatīti prayogaprasaṅgaḥ | tṛtīyā hi anabhihitayoḥ kartṛkaraṇyorvihitā ākhyātena ca karttā nābhihita iti kartṛvācino tṛtīyā syādeva | kartturabhidhāne tu abhihitatvādeva tṛtīyā na prāpnoti tasyā anabhihitādhikāratvāt | devadattaḥ pacatīti prathamā tu prāpnotyeva prathamāyā abhihitakārakavibhaktitvāt pratipadikārthamātravācitvāddā na ca tadā prātipadikenaivārthasyoktatvāt prathamāveyarghyam | liṅgasaprāpratipattyarthaṃ tasyā āvaśyakatvāt kevalaprātipadikasya prayogāsādhutvācca | tatatha yadi karttā na vācyaḥ syāddevadattena pacatīti prayogaḥ syāt tasmādākhyātavācyaḥ kartteti siddhamiti pūrvapacasaṅkṣepaḥ | atrāhuḥ | sa eva hi śabdasyārtho yaḥ prakārāntareṇa na labhyate ananyalabhyaḥ śabdārthaṃ iti nyāyāt | ataeva na gaṅgāpadasya tauramarthaḥ lakṣaṇayaiva pratipattisambhavāt | ataeva ca na vākyārthe śaktiḥ | evañcākhyātavācyabhāvanā karttāraṃ vinā anupapannā tamācipatauti | pācepādeva karttuḥ pratipattisambhave kimiti taddācakatvamākhyātasya kalpanīyam | na ca vinigamanāvirahaḥ kṛtimān hi karttā | evañca kṛtereva bhāvanāparapayayā ākkṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyenākhyātavācyatvasambhavena tadvataḥ kartturvācyatvaṃ kalpanīyaṃ gauravaprasaṅgāt | na ca bhāvanā kārakāntareṇāpi sambaddhā tadujjhitvā na jhaṭiti karttāramākṣipatīti vācyam | sā hi yathā niyamena kartā sambaḍā na tathā karaṇādikārakāntareṇa tiṣṭhatītyādiṣu tayā tadanākṣepāt | ataḥ prathamaṃ sā karttāramevācipati na kārakāntaram | ataeva cākhyātābhihitā saṅkhyā na kārakāntareṇa sambadhyate tasya prathamamanupasthiteḥ | ataeva tṛtīyādivibhaktīnāṃ karaṇādivācitvam | bhāvanāyāstaiḥ saha niyatasambandhābhāvena tayā teṣāṃ niyamenānākṣepāt ākhyātaśravaṇāt prāgapi tṛtīyādivibha ktiśravaṇe karaṇādipratīterjāyamānatvācca | na ca śābdī saṅkhyā kathamaśābdena karttānvatīti vācyam | kartturlakṣaṇāṅgīkārāt yathā ca lacitaṃ tauraṃ śābdena ghoṣeṇānveti evaṃ lakṣitaḥ karttā ekatvenānveṣyati | ataeva devadattaḥ pacatīti sāmānādhikarasyamupapadyate karttulakṣaṇāṅgīkārāt | na ca mukhya sambhavati kimiti lākṣaṇikatvaṃ svīkāyryamiti vācyam | ananyalabhyagabdārthatvasya vyavasthāpitatvāt anyathā siṃho devadatta iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ mukhya syāt | prāśasyajñānetikarttavyatākā śābdībhāvanā liṅtvāṃśenocyata iti | nanu keyaṃ śābdo bhāvanā | ucyate puruṣapravṛttyanukūlo vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ sa eva vidhyarthaḥ | liṅādiśravaṇe'yaṃ māṃ pravarttayatīti tasya niyamena pratīteḥ | yatt iṣṭasādhanatvaṃ vidhyarthaṃ iti tanna | tathā sati iṣṭasādhanamiti śavdasya vidhiśabdaḥ paryāyaḥ syāt | na ca paryāyatva' yujyate sandhyopāsanaṃ te dṛṣṭasādhanaṃ tasmāt tat tvaṃ kurviti sahaprayogāt | paryāvāṇāñca sahaprayogābhāvāt | śrataśca vyāpāraviśeṣa eva vidhyarthaḥ | sa ca loke puruṣaniṣṭho'bhiprāya viśeṣaḥ | vedetu puruṣābhāvācchabdaniṣṭha eva preraṇā paraparyyāya ityuktam | nanu loke śabdaniṣṭhe preraṇāparaparyāye vyāpāraśabdaprayogābhāvena śaktigrahābhāvāt kathaṃ tasya vidhiśabdāt pratītiriti cet ? satyametat tathāpi bālastāvat stanapānādau svakṛtarodanādijanitamātṛpravṛtteḥ svābhiprāyarūpapravattaṃ nānānajanyatvāvadhāraṇāt savidhikaprayojakavākyaśravaṇasamanantarabhāvinīṃ prayojyavṛddhavṛttimupalabhya tatkāraṇatvena tasya pravarttanājñānamanumimīte | yadyapi bhojanādau svapravṛtteḥ samīhitasādhanatājñānapūrvakatvāt prayojyapravṛtterapi tatpūrvakatvādhyavasānaṃ yuktam | tathāpyanyapreritapravṛttau pravarttanājñānajanyatva syoktamātṛpravṛttau darśanena prayojyavṛddhapravṛtterapi anya preritapravṛttitvātkāraṇatvena pravarttanājñānasyaivādhyavasānam | tacca pravarttanājñānamanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ prayojakavākyajanyamityavadhārayati | tatra cāvāpodāpābhyāṃ pravatenāyāṃ vidhiśaktimavadhārayati | prahṛtyanukūlo vyāpāraḥ pravarttanā | sa ca vyāpāraḥ praṣādirūpo vividha iti pratyekaṃ vyabhicāritvāddidhiśabdavāccatvānupapatteḥ pravarttanāsāmānyameva vidhiśabdavācyamiti kalpayati | evañca vidhiśravaṇe praiṣādirūpasya vaktrabhiprāyasya pravarttanātvenaiva rūpeṇa pratītirna viśeṣarūpeṇa | tathaiva śaktigrahāt | viśeṣarūpeṇa tu pratotirlakṣaṇayeva | evañca vaidikaliṅādiśravaṇe'pi pravarttanāsāmānyameva pratīyate | tatra ko'sau vyāpāra ityapekṣāyāṃ praiṣādirūpasya vaktrabhiprāyasyāporuṣaye vede'nupapatteḥ śābdaniṣṭha eva preraṇāparaparyāyaḥ kaścidyāpāra iti kalpate | ataśca śabdaniṣṭha eva preraṇāparaparyāyo vyāpāraḥ śābdo bhāvanā saiva ca pravarttanātvena rūpeṇa vidhyarthaṃ iti | ayameva cārtho'bhidhābhāvanā māhuranyāmeva liṅādaya iti vārttikasya | śrabhidhīyate'neneti vyutpattyā abhidhāśabdena śabda uccate tatrāpārātmikā bhāvanā liṅādivācyeti kecidācāryyāḥ | anya tvāhuḥ, satyaṃ pravartta nāsāmānya vidhyarthaḥ tathaiva śaktigrahāt pravṛttyanukūlaśca vyāpāraḥ pravarttanā | apauruṣeye ca vede praiṣāderasambhavāt kaścit puruṣapravṛttyā anukūlo'sau vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ kalpanīyaḥ | vidhiśabdābhidheyapravartta nāsāmānyasya viśeṣamantareṇa aparyyavasānāt | tatra ko'sau vyāpāra ityapekṣāyāṃ dhātvarthagataṃ samīhitasādhanatvameveti kalpate | tasyāpi khapravṛttyanukūlatvāt sarvo hi samīhitasādhanatāṃ jñātvā pravarttate | anyaprerito'pi yadīṣṭasādhanatāṃ na jānāti tadā naiva pravarttate svatantra preraṇāvāde'pi tadāciptasamīhitasādhanatājñānaṃ svīkriyate eva anyathā vidheḥ pravattakatvānupapatteḥ | atyāvaśyakatvāt samīhitasādhanataiva pravarttanātva ena rūpeṇa vidhyarthaḥ | evañca vidhiśabdasyāpara niṣṭhavyāpārabodhakatva' lokasi bhavati | kiñca śabda eko vyāparaḥ spandādyatiriktaḥ kalpanīyaḥ | tasya ca svapravṛttau parādhīnapravṛttau vā karaṇatve nāklṛptasya pravarttanātvena rūpeṇa jñātasya pravṛttyanukūlatvam | śabdasya ca paraniṣṭhavyāpārajñāpakatvena kṛtasya khaniṣṭha vyāpārabodhakatvam | vidheśca pravarttakatvanirvāhārthaṃ dhātvarthasya samohitasādhanatvamiti kalpanāddaramāvaśyakasyaiva samīhitasādhanatvasya svapravṛttihetutvena klaptasya pravarttanātvena rūpeṇa vidhyartha tvakalpanaṃ lāghavāt anyaniṣṭhatvācca | na ca vidheḥ pravarttakatva nirvāhārtha samīhitasādhanatvakalpanāt preraṇānabhidhāne ca vidherapravarttakatvāt dhātvarthasya samauhitasādhanatvakalpanameva nāstīti vācam | pravarttanābhidhānena etanmate'pi vidheḥ pravarttakatvāt | vidhyabhihitasya ca pravarttanāsāmānyasya viśeṣamantare paryavasānātsamīhitasādhanatvācepakatvāt | na ceṣṭasādhanatvasya vidhyarthatve sandhyopāsanaṃ te dṛṣṭasādhanaṃ tat tvaṃ kurviti sahaprayogānupapattiriti vācyam | pravadṛṣṭasādhanatvasya viśeṣarūpeṇa vidhinānabhidhānāt | tenātvena rūpeṇābhidhānāt | sāmānyaśabdasya ca viśeṣaśabdena dṛṣṭaḥ sahaprayogaḥ | pāñcālīrājā drupada ityādau | tasmātsamauhitasādhanataiva pravarttanātvena rūpeṇa vidhyarthaḥ | sevaca tena rūpeṇa śabda naivābhidhīyate iti śāvdī bhāvanā | uktavārttikasyāpyayamevābhiprāyaḥ | śrabhidhīyate sābhidhā samīhitasādhanatā seva pravattanātvena abhihitā puruṣapravṛtti bhāvayatīti bhāvanā to liṅādaya āhuriti | yathāhuḥ, puso neṣṭābhyupāyatvāt kriyāsvanyaḥ pravarttakaḥ | pravṛttihetu' dharmañca pravadanti pravarttanām || iti tatsiddam | yajetetyatra litvāṃśena śābdī bhāvanocyate | iti ākhyātāṃśena cātrārthī bhāvanocyate | nanu keyamārthī bhāvanā | kartṛ vyāpāra iti cet ? na | yāgāderapi tayāpāratvena bhāvanātvāpatteḥ | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ | tasya prakṛtyarthatvena pratyayārthatvābhāvāditi cedatrāhuḥ | satyaṃ na yāgo bhāvanā | kintu svargecchājanito yāgaviṣayo yaḥ prayatnaḥ sā bhāvanā | sa eva cākhyātāṃśenocyate yajetetyākhyātaśravaṇo yāge yajeteti pratītaṃjayamānatvāt | yaśca yatnapūrvakaṃ gamanādi karoti tasmin devadatto gamanaṃ karotīti prayogadarśanāt | vātādinā spandamāne tu nāyaṃ karoti kintu vātādinā asya spando jāyate iti prayogāt karotyarthastāvatprayatnaḥ | karoti sāmānādhikaraṇyañcākhyāte ha śyate | yajeta yāgena kuryyāt pacati pākaṃ karoti gacchati gamanaṃ karotīti | ataśca karotisāmānādhikaraṇyāprayatnasyākhyātavācyatvam | na ca ratho gacchatīti prayogānupapattiḥ rathe yatnābhāvāditi vācyam | vodarantargataṃ prayatna rathe śrāropya prayogopapatteḥ | yanmate'pyanyotpādānukūlaṃ vyāpārasāmānyaṃ bhāvanā tanmate'pi rathe gamanātiriktavyāpārānupalabdheḥ | ratho gacchatīti prayogasyopacārikatvameveti śrataśca prayatna evārtho bhāvanā | yathāhuḥ, prayatnavyatiriktārthabhāvanā tu na śakyate | vaktumākhyātavācce ha prastute'pyuparamyata iti | anya tvāhuḥ bhavitubhāvanānukūlo bhāvakavyāpārastāvadbhāvanā | yasmin vyāpāre kṛte karaṇaṃ phalotpādanāya samarthaṃ bhavati tāhaśo vyāpāra iti yāvat | sa eva cākhyātārthaḥ | kuṭhāreṇa chinatti ityākhyātaśravaṇe hi bhavatya tādṛśau matiḥ | kuṭhāreṇa tathā vyāpriyeta yasmin vyāpāre kṛte kuṭhāreṇa chedanaṃ bhavatīti | evaṃ yajeta svargakāma ityasyāyamarthaḥ | yāgena tathā vyāpriyate yasmin vyāpāre kṛte yāgāt svargā bhavatīti | sa ca vyāpāraḥ kvacidudyamananipatanādiḥ kvaciccāgnyādhānādibrāhmaṇatarpaṇāntaḥ | kathambhāvākāṅgāyāṃ viśeṣarūpeṇa paścādavagamyate | anyotpādanānukūlatvena sāmānyatastvākhyāta evāvagamyate | ratho grāmaṃ gacchatītyākhyātena grāmaprātyanukūlo vyāpāra eva pratīyate | rathastathāgamane vyāpriyate yasmin vyāpāre kṛte gamanāda grāmaprāptirbhavatīti pratīteḥ | natvatra gamanamātramākhyātārthaḥ | tasya dhātunoktatvāt | tatra ko'sau vyāpāra ityapekṣāyāṃ pūrvottarāvāntara deśavibhajanasaṃyojanarūpa iti paścādavagamyate | pūrveṇa pradeśena viyujyottareṇa saṃyujya ratho grāmaṃ gacchatauti prayogāt | udyamyanipātya kuṭhāreṇa chinattītivat | evaṃ devadattaḥ prayatate ityatrāpi devadattastathā vyāpriyate yathā prayatnī bhavatīti | prayatnānukūlo vyāpāra evākhyātārtho na tu prayatnaḥ tasya dhātunoktatvāt | vyāpāraviśeṣākāṅgāyāñca icchādiḥ paścādavagamyate udyamanapatanavat | tathā ca sarvatrānugatatvādanyotpādānukūlaṃ vyāpārasāmānyamevākhyātārthaḥ | na tu prayatnamāttram | ratho gacchati devadattaḥ prayatate ityādiṣu tadabhāvāt | na cātraupacārikatvaṃ vaktu yuktam | mukhye sambhavati tasyānyāyyatvāt | karotyartho'pyanyotpādānukūlo vyāpāra eva na prayatnamātram | karoteścetanācetanakarṭa kākhyātasāmānādhikaraṇyāditi | tatsiddhamanyotpādānukūlo vyāpāra ārdhī bhāvaneti | saiva ca yajetetyākhyātāṃśenocyate bhāvayediti | tasyāśca bhāvyākāṅgāyāṃ svargādi bhāvyatvena sagvadhyaṃte | karaṇākāṅkṣāyāṃ yāgādiḥ karaṇatvena mambadhyate | prayājādaya itikarttavyatātvena | evañca yajetetyādinā svargādyuddeśena yāgādervidhānāt siddha' yāgāderdharmatva' prayojanamuddiśya vedena vihitatvāditi | so'yaṃ dharmo yaduddeśena vihitastaduddeśena kriyamāṇastadvetuḥ | śrīgovindārpaṇabuḍyā kriyamāṇastu niḥśre. yasahetuḥ | na ca tadarpaṇabuḍyānuṣṭhāne pramāṇābhāvaḥ | " yatkaroṣi yadaśnāsi yajja hoṣi dadāsi yat | yattapasyasi konteya ! tatkuruṣva madarpaṇam ||" iti smṛtaḥ || asyāścāṣṭakādismṛtivatprāmāṇyādinyatra vistaraḥ | "kvāhaṃ mandamatiḥ keyaṃ prakriyā bhāṭṭasaṃmatā | tasmādbhaktervilāso'yaṃ govinda gurupādayoḥ | grantharūpo madauyo'yaṃ vāgvyāpāraḥ suśobhanaḥ || anena proyatāṃ devo govindo bhaktavatsalaḥ || " iti śranantadevasūnunā āpadevena kṛtaṃ mīmāṃsānyāyaprakāśa' jñasakaṃ momāṃsāprakaraṇaṃ samāptimagamat |
